objective: Determine exactly what the historical WT positive can and cannot establish, then freeze a falsifiable factorial design that isolates recursive history use, post-reveal RLS adaptation and origin-relative clipping before any new outcome is inspected.
causal_question: Does recursive use of predicted state/history contribute quality or recovery beyond a classical affine VAR(2)/ARX predictor, post-reveal RLS adaptation and clipping, or is the historical gain fully explained by those classical mechanisms and stabilization?
scope: Resolve EXP-20260831-0006 and EXP-20260831-0007 candidate plus dependencies from their immutable result hashes and Git commit; do not execute historical code.
Record the exact algebraic identity of ridge on [1, x_t, x_t-x_(t-1), u_t] as an affine controlled VAR(2), with separate RLS and clipping operations.
Freeze one source-identical 2x2x2 implementation contract with recurrence/history-delta R, post-reveal RLS U and origin-relative bound C as the only causal switches.

Define R=0 as one-step prediction from the last revealed history followed by persistence of that predicted level across the requested horizon; it neither recursively feeds predictions nor uses a predicted history delta.

Require the R1-U1-C1 cell to reproduce historical source behavior on outcome-free fixtures and require a separately named algebraic VAR(2)+RLS+bound control to match it within declared floating-point tolerance.

Define paired factorial estimands over independent physical trace units, not overlapping windows or runner permutations; preserve per-unit, per-horizon, stability, recovery, operation, byte-touch and state-memory outputs.
Separate known-data historical diagnosis, genuinely new same-protocol physical traces for replication and wt_walks_v1 only as a possible different-operation adversarial stratum.
Record that all ten local wt_changepoints_v1 files are already visible/used and cannot become fresh final replication data by repartitioning.
Do not freeze a numerical effect threshold until measurement noise and a development-only scale are documented prospectively; freeze it before final access in the next service cycle or stop.
Validate the immutable records, run focused tests, the complete pytest suite, doctor and integrity without invoking the scored runner.
required_controls: exact algebraic VAR(2)/ARX representation of the historical affine rule
frozen-update counterpart for every recurrence/bound configuration
unbounded counterpart for every recurrence/update configuration with divergence recorded rather than repaired
a fairly charged nonlinear NARX control only if its degree/features/regularization are frozen from development data before final access

success: The historical identity and classical equivalence are hash-bound; every factorial cell and estimand is unambiguous; the independent-data receipt prevents seed/file pseudo-replication; tests, doctor and integrity pass with scoring closed; the exact remaining data/harness decision is stated.
failure: Preserve every record and stop with the exact ambiguity, provenance, independence, validation or integrity blocker. Do not invent a threshold, inspect a new outcome, weaken a gate or start a development/scored experiment.
next_action_on_success: Stop for explicit review before the second and final WT-01 service cycle: data acquisition/receipt plus source-identical harness implementation and pre-outcome freeze, still without scoring unless separately authorized.
next_action_on_failure: Stop at WT-01-CONTRACT with the concrete blocker; no factorial run.
